summary: Public projects created on 5 March 2026: 2 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Two repositories cover agent tooling: a Claude Code agent that generates batches of platform-specific search dorks, and examples of situational reports for agentic generation or general authorship. A training dataset tracks Iranian missile and drone attack waves against Israel and US and coalition targets across four operations in the True Promise series.
